title: Haye Naizy Pay Woh Zainab Ki
body:
Haye neyzey pay woh Zainab ki, rida tak’ta raha
Shaam aa kay bhi woh har pal,,,, karbala tak’ta raha
Woh Sakina terey kaanon,,, ki dawa tak’ta raha
patharon ki baarishon mein,,,, raasta tak’ta raha
Ro kay masooma kay cheh’rey,,,, pay khuda tak’ta raha
Kon Zainab lafz sun ker,,,, chup raha tak’ta raha
Woh Ali ki beytion ko,,,, bey rida tak’ta raha
Sun kay aabid mar gaya phir, phir khara tak’ta raha
karbala mein kibriya ko,,, kibriya tak’ta raha
